viral_ticker_tweets.title_en:
We’ve trained Claude to flag potential misuse in conversations, a technique we call self-assessment. Right after it responds, Claude gives a preliminary safety assessment of the conversation. 

Since we began using self-assessment in June, it has surfaced misuse that our other safeguards weren’t designed to catch. 

Because Claude has already read the conversation, self-assessment is very efficient. And unlike classifiers, which target a discrete set of harms, it draws on Claude’s own judgment, so it gets more accurate as our models improve.

Read more on our new Safeguards blog:
https://t.co/18j6zdHub4

top_three.content_snippet: Britain's competition regulator on Friday said it has opened an investigation into whether Meta (META.O) was imposing exploitative terms …
top_three.summary_en: The UK Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) has launched an antitrust investigation into Meta, examining whether the tech giant abused its market dominance to impose exploitative terms on publishers and advertisers. The regulator suspect Meta forced content creators to forfeit proprietary text and ad materials for training its AI models without fair compensation or viable opt-out options. This move marks an escalating regulatory crackdown on Big Tech scraping ecosystem content under the guise of platform service terms.

ai_analysis.briefing_zh: 英国竞争与市场管理局正式对Meta启动反垄断立案调查，重点审查该公司是否滥用在社交媒体和数字广告领域的市场支配地位，对内容出版商与广告客户施加苛刻的剥削性条款。监管机构怀疑Meta强制将其平台上客户创作的新闻、文章和广告素材无偿或廉价捆绑用于自身AI大模型及算法服务的研发迭代。随着内容版权方与生成式AI阵营的摩擦加剧，监管部门正试图切断大厂利用平台生态优势巧取豪夺训练数据的行为路径。

top_three.title: US antitrust regulators are scrutinizing Nvidia's Hugging Face deal and sales practices
top_three.title_en: US antitrust regulators are scrutinizing Nvidia's Hugging Face deal and sales practices
top_three.author: THE DECODER
top_three.article_content:
The US Justice Department is looking into Nvidia's planned acquisition of open-source platform Hugging Face. According to two sources cited by Reuters, department officials are asking whether the purchase could give Nvidia control over a key hub for distributing AI and hurt its competitors. The deal is worth $12.93 billion, and Nvidia expects it to close in the first half of 2027. The company says Hugging Face will keep supporting partnerships with a range of chip, cloud, and AI providers.

At the same time, US antitrust regulators are investigating Nvidia's acquisitions, investments, sales practices, and possible pressure on customers. The probe started under Joe Biden and has continued under Donald Trump. According to the sources, officials have also looked at Nvidia's acquisitions of SchedMD and Run:ai, along with its licensing deal with Groq. They're also checking whether Nvidia offered customers more AI chips if they bought Nvidia networking gear and Groq processors too.

Nvidia faces scrutiny in Europe as well. France's competition authority is investigating the company over alleged anticompetitive business practices. The regulator is concerned about the industry's dependence on Nvidia's CUDA programming software and about Nvidia's stakes in cloud providers like CoreWeave. It pointed to possible risks such as supply restrictions, unfair contract terms, and discrimination against certain customers.

stance_matrix.action_advice_en: Benchmark in isolated sandboxes for agentic tasks, leveraging Ollama for zero-data-retention private hosting.

news.summary_en: Pope Leo XIV officially called for the UN to move toward banning lethal autonomous weapons during an address. news.author: The Verge AI
news.content_snippet:
After months of bombarding mathematicians  with a relentless stream of AI-generated results, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says he sympathizes with researchers struggling to make sense of it all. But he has no intention of stopping - and hints there could be much more to come from the company's stockpile of discoveries.

news.summary_en: During a podcast appearance, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed the overwhelming influx of AI-generated proofs flooding the mathematics community, stating that while he sympathizes with researchers struggling to verify the barrage, OpenAI has no intention of slowing down. He further revealed that the company possesses a stockpile of new discoveries waiting to be released, defending the onslaught under the banner of advancing humanity's understanding of the universe.

news.title: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
news.title_en: Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
Epoch AI researchers say the widely available AI model GLM 5.3 turned public security fixes into working exploits before updates reached Firefox users. It autonomously compromised six Firefox releases for about $1,000 in API fees each without triggering safeguards from any provider tested.

The article Open-weight model GLM 5.3 built full Firefox exploit chains with zero human input in under 48 hours appeared first on The Decoder.
news.summary_en: Researchers found that the open-weight model GLM 5.3 autonomously analyzed public security patches to build full exploit chains for Firefox within 48 hours without human input. Operating at an API cost of approximately $1,000, it successfully compromised six Firefox releases while bypassing all existing provider safeguards.

【起因与机理】验证AI在自动化网络安全攻击中的潜在危险性
【关键数据与实测】该模型以约1000美元的API调用成本，成功攻破了六个不同版本的火狐，且全过程未触发任何安全预警防御机制。

news.title: The Download: GLP-1s and eating disorders, self-aware cities, and forever chemicals
news.title_en: The Download: GLP-1s and eating disorders, self-aware cities, and forever chemicals
news.author: MIT Tech Review
news.content_snippet:
Eating disorders are on the rise. GLP-1s could make things worse.

GLP-1 weight-loss drugs are one of the biggest biotech breakthroughs of the last decade. But to some clinicians, they can represent something sinister—a potential trigger for eating disorders.

A new report suggests the global incidence of anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa shot up by 71% between 1990 and 2023. And clinicians are already seeing GLP-1s exacerbate the issue.
news.summary_en: A new report reveals a 71% increase in the global incidence of anorexia and bulimia between 1990 and 2023. While GLP-1 weight-loss drugs represent a major biotech breakthrough, clinicians are concerned that their usage may act as a trigger, exacerbating the risks of eating disorders.

【起因与机理】基于过去三十年进食障碍发病率增长与药物使用的关联观察
【关键数据与实测】研究报告显示，自1990年至2023年，全球厌食症与暴食症发病率上升了71%。
【观点态度】医疗界对药物副作用的隐忧。

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Observed correlation between rising eating disorder incidence and drug usage

[Perspective & Impact] Medical community’s concern over side effects.

Just days before voters head to the polls, the rapid expansion of r

What’s worse is that the number is likely to be much highe

Clinicians fear that widespread off-label use for rapid weight loss legitimizes obsessive food restriction and fuels dangerous psychological triggers.

news.title_en: TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)

news.title: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
news.title_en: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)
news.author: NBC News
news.content_snippet: The DeepSeek AI mobile app.Andrey Rudakov / Bloomberg via Getty Add NBC News to GoogleOct. 29, 2026, 6:00 PM EDTBy Kevin CollierChinese state-linked hackers used artificial intelligence, including the popular DeepSeek model, to launch cyberattacks against more than 200 organizations around the world in just 11 days, according to the cybersecurity company CrowdStrike, in a campaign that illustrates how AI is allowing hackers to operate on a scale that previously required far more human effort.
news.summary_en: Threat actors deployed an automated tool named ARTEX, integrated with the DeepSeek LLM and an additional model, to target over 200 global organizations within just 11 days, successfully breaching at least nine. The campaign leverages generative AI to dramatically compress the reconnaissance and exploit lifecycle, demonstrating how LLMs transform labor-intensive cyber intrusions into scalable, industrialized operations.
news.title_zh: 黑客利用深度求索等大模型工具 11天内猛攻两百家机构
news.summary_zh: 黑客组织利用集成了深度求索等大模型的AI工具，在11天内对全球超200家机构发动网络攻击并攻破至少9家
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】疑似具备特定国家背景的黑客组织与受害网络机构在全球范围内的目标机构网络与云端服务器基础设施：利用集成深度求索大模型的AI渗透工具，11天内高频攻击200余家机构并攻陷至少9家
【起因与机理】借助前沿开源大模型极高的推理性价比与自动化能力，实现网络渗透测试与漏洞攻击的工业化规模扩张
【关键数据与实测】攻击者将深度求索等大模型嵌入自研渗透工具，11天内攻陷至少9家机构。
【观点态度】开源大模型的高效推理正被滥用于攻击链前置阶段，大幅压低人工渗透门槛。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] State-linked threat actors and targeted global organizations: Weaponized an AI intrusion tool integrated with DeepSeek to assault 200+ targets in 11 days, breaching at least nine
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Leveraged low-cost, high-speed open-source AI reasoning to scale and industrialize reconnaissance and exploitation
[Key Specification] Adversaries initiated high-velocity cyber campaigns across 200+ global entities.
[Perspective & Impact] Open-source LLMs are drastically lowering the barrier to entry for industrialized cyber reconnaissance.

news.title: Sources: DeepSeek doubled its latest round's size due to surging black market Nvidia Blackwell chip prices, with Chinese state-owned investors representing 27% (The Information)
news.title_en: Sources: DeepSeek doubled its latest round's size due to surging black market Nvidia Blackwell chip prices, with Chinese state-owned investors representing 27% (The Information)
news.author: The Information
news.content_snippet: Chinese AI star DeepSeek's nearly $16 billion funding round this month involved not only a deluge of capital but a who's …
news.summary_en: DeepSeek has doubled its latest funding round to nearly $16 billion to cope with soaring costs of procuring Nvidia Blackwell chips on the black market. With state-owned investors accounting for approximately 27% of the round, the move highlights how domestic AI firms are aggressively securing capital to bypass chip-related trade restrictions.
news.title_zh: 深度求索融资翻倍以应对高昂算力成本
news.summary_zh: 深度求索融资额翻倍至近160亿美元，部分资金用于应对黑市溢价的英伟达芯片采购，国资背景注资占比约27%
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】深度求索 (DeepSeek在一级资本市场融资及芯片采购渠道：融资额翻倍至近160亿美元，主要为消化高额算力采购成本
【起因与机理】受限于英伟达顶级芯片获取难度及黑市价格过高，叠加算力竞赛压力
【关键数据与实测】深度求索融资额倍增至近160亿美元。
【观点态度】国资入局占比超四分之一，突显算力获取的战略紧迫性。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] DeepSeek: Doubled funding to nearly $16 billion to cover inflating chip costs
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Rising costs of Nvidia chips on the black market and the urgent need for competitive computing power
[Key Metrics] DeepSeek's funding round surges to $16 billion.
[Perspective & Impact] State-backed investors account for over 27% of the round, highlighting strategic urgency.

news.author: Wall Street Journal
news.content_snippet: Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America's top foreign policy interests.
news.summary_en: Anthropic's S-1 filing reveals a critical dependency on TSMC for AI chip manufacturing. The company warns that any potential supply chain disruption stemming from geopolitical tensions in the Taiwan Strait would pose a severe threat to its operational continuity.
news.title_zh: Anthropic披露严重依赖台积电

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Regulatory compliance and investor risk disclosure
[Key Specification] Anthropic addresses supply chain vulnerability in IPO docs.
[Perspective & Impact] Warns of existential threat from geopolitical volatility.

news.title: Sources: Indian AI infrastructure company AM Intelligence seeks to raise as much as $3B to fund a previously announced purchase of Nvidia Vera Rubin systems (Bloomberg)
news.title_en: Sources: Indian AI infrastructure company AM Intelligence seeks to raise as much as $3B to fund a previously announced purchase of Nvidia Vera Rubin systems (Bloomberg)
news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet: Indian AI infrastructure firm AM Intelligence is seeking to raise as much as $3 billion to fund a previously announced purchase …
news.summary_en: Indian AI infrastructure firm AM Intelligence has launched a $3 billion fundraising round specifically to procure Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin AI computing systems. This move aims to secure a competitive edge by locking in elite hardware as global demand for AI infrastructure intensifies.

fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] AM Intelligence, an Indian AI infrastructure firm: Seeking to raise $3 billion to purchase Nvidia's Vera Rubin AI systems

[Key Metrics] Seeking $3B to buy Nvidia's Vera Rubin chips.
[Perspective & Impact] Leveraging capital to secure global compute capacity.

news.title: NYSE owner ICE plans US-regulated Hyperliquid-based perpetual markets with Trade.xyz, a market operator on the crypto platform, and takes a stake in Trade.xyz (Katherine Doherty/Bloomberg)
news.title_en: NYSE owner ICE plans US-regulated Hyperliquid-based perpetual markets with Trade.xyz, a market operator on the crypto platform, and takes a stake in Trade.xyz (Katherine Doherty/Bloomberg)
news.author: Bloomberg
news.content_snippet: Intercontinental Exchange Inc. joined forces with one of the market operators behind offshore crypto-trading platform Hyperliquid …
news.summary_en: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), parent company of the NYSE, has taken an equity stake in Trade.xyz, a prominent market operator on decentralized platform Hyperliquid. The two partners plan to launch US-regulated perpetual futures markets built on Hyperliquid's infrastructure. This initiative reflects traditional finance's drive to capture booming crypto derivatives volume by integrating DeFi liquidity into Wall Street's regulatory framework.
news.title_zh: 纽交所母公司入股Trade推合规链上永续合约

【起因与机理】传统金融资本觊觎链上永续合约庞大的交易手续费与流动性，试图通过合规牌照收编去中心化金融创新
【关键技术规格】纽交所母公司洲际交易所入股Trade.xyz。
【观点态度】传统金融加速收编去中心化衍生品流动性。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) and crypto market operator Trade.xyz: ICE invested in Trade.xyz to jointly launch US-regulated perpetual markets powered by Hyperliquid
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Traditional finance seeks to tap into high-margin DeFi perpetual volumes and bring unregulated crypto trading under Wall Street control
[Key Specification] NYSE owner ICE acquires equity stake in Trade.xyz.
[Perspective & Impact] Traditional finance accelerates absorption of DeFi liquidity.

news.title: Binance "temporarily suspended" all deposits and withdrawals as it investigates security issues and works with law enforcement; Binance.US says it's unaffected (George Steer/Financial Times)
news.title_en: Binance "temporarily suspended" all deposits and withdrawals as it investigates security issues and works with law enforcement; Binance.US says it's unaffected (George Steer/Financial Times)
news.author: Financial Times
news.content_snippet: Tether and Circle freeze billions of dollars' worth of their coins as world's largest crypto exchange investigates security issue
news.summary_en: Binance has abruptly suspended all cryptocurrency deposits and withdrawals globally as it investigates an ongoing security incident and coordinates with law enforcement agencies. While Binance.US claimed its domestic operations remain unaffected, major stablecoin issuers have moved rapidly to freeze suspicious associated assets on-chain.
news.title_zh: 币安紧急暂停充提币配合执法机构排查安全漏洞
news.summary_zh: 全球最大加密交易所币安突发暂停全网充提现，正配合执法部门调查安全事件，旗下美区业务称不受影响
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】币安加密货币交易平台及相关执法机构在全球加密资产交易网络与清算系统：全面关停充值提现通道以排查安全风险，并与警方联合开展资金冻结行动
【起因与机理】遭遇突发链上安全隐患与黑客盗刷或洗钱风险，需紧急截断异常资金链条
【关键技术规格】币安全网突发关闭充值提现功能。
【观点态度】币安美区声称未受波及，事件折射中心化交易所的应急兜底软肋。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Binance and relevant law enforcement agencies: Temporarily suspended all deposits and withdrawals while collaborating with police to trace and freeze assets
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Mitigating potential exploit risks, security breaches, and illicit fund movements
[Key Specification] Binance abruptly halted all deposits and withdrawals globally.
[Perspective & Impact] Binance.US claimed it is unaffected, though the freeze highlights core custody risks.

news.title: Twilio reports Q3 revenue up 20% YoY to $1.56B, vs. $1.52B est., net income up 333% to $161M, and expects slower Q4 revenue growth; TWLO drops 15%+ after hours (Elias Schisgall/MarketWatch)
news.title_en: Twilio reports Q3 revenue up 20% YoY to $1.56B, vs. $1.52B est., net income up 333% to $161M, and expects slower Q4 revenue growth; TWLO drops 15%+ after hours (Elias Schisgall/MarketWatch)
news.author: MarketWatch
news.content_snippet: Twilio lifted its full-year revenue growth outlook after the company reported a higher profit and revenue growth in the third quarter.
news.summary_en: Twilio reported Q3 revenue of $1.56 billion (up 20% YoY), beating estimates of $1.52 billion, alongside a 333% surge in net income to $161 million. However, despite raising its full-year guidance, projections of slower revenue growth for Q4 triggered investor anxiety, sending its stock plummeting over 15% in after-hours trading.
news.title_zh: 云通信巨头Twilio净利暴增三倍却因指引疲软盘后重挫15%
news.summary_zh: Twilio第三季度净利润暴增333%，但因第四季度营收增速预期放缓，引发盘后股价重挫超15%
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】云通信平台Twilio在第三季度财报发布会及美股盘后交易市场：Q3营收15.6亿美元、净利润暴增333%超预期，但因Q4营收指引放缓导致股价盘后大跌超15%
【起因与机理】宏观企业预算趋紧与通信用量见顶隐忧显现，华尔街对未来增长疲软的容忍度极低并予以重罚
【关键数据与实测】季度营收15.6亿美元且净利润飙升333%，但第四季度营收增长指引弱于预期。
【观点态度】华尔街对增长放缓极度敏感，导致盘后股价暴跌超15%。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Twilio: Reported strong Q3 revenue beat and 333% net profit surge, but warned of slower Q4 growth, sending shares down 15%+
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Wall Street punished soft forward-looking guidance amidst worries over slowing enterprise communications spending
[Key Metrics] Revenue reached $1.56B with 333% profit jump, but Q4 growth guidance showed deceleration.
[Perspective & Impact] Hypersensitive investors punished the soft outlook, wiping 15%+ off the stock after hours.

news.title: Andy Jassy says Prime Video has "a revenue run rate in the tens of billions of dollars and is now profitable in its own right" (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: Andy Jassy says Prime Video has "a revenue run rate in the tens of billions of dollars and is now profitable in its own right" (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
It’s been four years since Amazon bought MGM for $8.5 billion. But coming off the blockbuster success of this year’s hit movie Project Hail Mary, Hollywood has become a lucrative business for the e-commerce giant.

Prime Video, Amazon’s streaming service, “has emerged as a significant business with a revenue run rate in the tens of billions of dollars and is now profitable in its own right,” Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on the quarterly earnings call on Thursday. Jassy had previously told investor
news.summary_en: During Amazon's quarterly earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy announced that Prime Video's revenue run rate has reached tens of billions of dollars and the streaming platform has become independently profitable. Bolstered by the $8.5B MGM acquisition and box-office hits like Project Hail Mary, Amazon MGM Studios has generated over $1.2B in global theatrical box office receipts this year.
news.title_zh: 亚马逊宣布视频业务年营收数百亿且已实现独立盈利
news.summary_zh: 亚马逊CEO安迪·贾西宣布Prime Video年营收达数百亿美元且已独立盈利，米高梅工作室今年票房破12亿
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】亚马逊首席执行官安迪·贾西（Andy Jassy在亚马逊季度财报电话会议：宣布Prime Video年营收达数百亿美元且实现独立盈利，米高梅工作室年票房突破12亿美元
【起因与机理】通过引入贴片广告、发力院线大片与爆款剧集变现，将原有的电商会员附赠权益转化为自负盈亏的高毛利娱乐业务
【关键数据与实测】借助斥资85亿美元收购米高梅工作室后的资源整合，以及《挽救计划》等全球热卖院线电影的助推，亚马逊米高梅工作室今年全球院线票房累计已突破12亿美元。
【观点态度】得益于米高梅并购整合与院线票房成功，原电商附属业务成功完成商业化蜕变。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Amazon CEO Andy Jassy (Quarterly earnings conference call): Disclosed Prime Video's run-rate in tens of billions with standalone profitability, and over $1.2B in global box office
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Monetizing streaming through ads and theatrical releases to transform a membership perk into a self-sustaining profit engine
[Key Metrics] Bolstered by the $8.5B MGM acquisition and box-office hits like Project Hail Mary, Amazon MGM Studios has generated over $1.2B in global theatrical box office receipts this year.
[Perspective & Impact] The MGM integration and global box office hits turned an e-commerce perk into a commercial powerhouse.

news.title: Meta quietly launches Style Sketch, an AI fashion app that helps users put together outfit ideas using clothes they own, in Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand (Aisha Malik/TechCrunch)
news.title_en: Meta quietly launches Style Sketch, an AI fashion app that helps users put together outfit ideas using clothes they own, in Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand (Aisha Malik/TechCrunch)
news.author: TechCrunch
news.content_snippet:
Meta has quietly launched Style Sketch, an AI fashion app that helps users put together outfit ideas using clothes they already own. The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve posted, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.

Style Sketch then suggests outfit combinations built from your wardrobe matched to your style. Users can then try on the outfits on a “realistic model matched to y
news.summary_en: Meta has launched its AI-powered fashion app, Style Sketch, in Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand, allowing users to build a virtual wardrobe by syncing with Instagram or manual uploads. The app uses AI to generate personalized outfit combinations and realistic virtual try-ons tailored to the user's body shape and skin tone.

news.title: On Amazon's earnings call, Andy Jassy says outside AI shopping agents are "still not great, nor more convenient than coming to a retailer directly" (Sebastian Herrera/Fortune)
news.title_en: On Amazon's earnings call, Andy Jassy says outside AI shopping agents are "still not great, nor more convenient than coming to a retailer directly" (Sebastian Herrera/Fortune)
news.author: Fortune
news.content_snippet:
Amazon Chief Executive Andy Jassy told investors Thursday not to worry about bots invading its online store and rendering it useless.

Jassy’s comments, made during a call with analysts following the company’s quarterly earnings report, came about a month after the e-commerce giant blocked Meta Platforms’ popular new AI assistant, Muse, from accessing its online store. Amazon said in September that Muse’s access would violate the conditions of use its customers have agreed to.

While not naming
news.summary_en: During a quarterly earnings call, Amazon CEO Andy Jassy reassured investors that external AI shopping agents remain clunky and far less convenient than shopping directly on retail platforms. Coming a month after Amazon blocked Meta's AI assistant from its store citing terms-of-service violations, Jassy aimed to calm Wall Street's fears of outside bots disintermediating its commerce empire while highlighting that Amazon's own shopping AI has served over 400 million users and boosted average US basket sizes by 50%.

news.summary_zh: 亚马逊首席执行官在财报会上安抚投资人，称第三方AI代购体验欠佳，并力推自家已拥有超4亿用户的购物助手
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】亚马逊首席执行官安迪·贾西（Andy Jassy在季度财报分析师电话会议：公开唱衰外部AI代购体验拉跨，同时极力推介自家的官方购物助手以提振投资者信心
【起因与机理】先前强势封杀Meta旗下AI代理引发市场对电商入口易主的担忧，急需稳固自身流量壁垒与广告变现商业模式
【关键数据与实测】贬低第三方AI代购体验不及直接进站购物，力推官方助手并透露其让客单价暴涨50%。
【观点态度】封杀Meta助手后筑牢围墙花园，力保零售交易闭环与流量税收益不被外来智能体截流。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Amazon CEO Andy Jassy: Criticized third-party AI shopping agents as clunky and inconvenient while actively touting Amazon's in-house assistant metrics to reassure shareholders

[Root Cause & Mechanism] Following Amazon's move to block Meta's AI agent, Jassy needed to counter investor fears of platform disintermediation and protect Amazon's high-margin retail traffic and ad engine
[Key Metrics] Dismisses outside shopping agents as inferior while revealing official AI lifted basket sizes by 50%.
[Perspective & Impact] Strengthens retail garden walls after banning Meta's assistant to safeguard monetization loops.

news.author: MarketWatch

Less than two years after it became an independent company again, Sandisk plans to conduct a stock split.

Shares are up more than 2,600% since the company separated from Western Digital (WDC) in February 2025, according to Dow Jones Market Data. They've become one of the highest-priced components in the S&P 500 SPX, finishing Thursday at $1,330. Just five companies in the index had higher stock prices than that as of the close.

A high stock price in isolation doesn't mean much, especially in a
news.summary_en: Sandisk reported a 378% year-over-year surge in Q1 revenue to $11 billion alongside an upbeat Q2 forecast, and announced an 8-for-1 stock split to lower share price following a 2,600% rally since its spin-off. Despite beating Wall Street expectations across the board, SNDK shares fell over 4% in after-hours trading due to heavy profit-taking.

celebrity.title_zh:
声明的实际内容比推文还要疯狂。她要求他为将高价与我们对以色列的支持挂钩而道歉。这是谴责和不满的清单，而不是认可。在这里阅读：

“几天来，阿卜杜勒对哈桑·皮克（Hasan Piker）叔叔岑克·维吾尔（Cenk Uygur）制作的叛乱政治行
celebrity.full_text_en:
The actual text of the statement is even more insane than the tweet. She is demanding he apologize for tying high prices to our support for Israel. This is a condemnation and list of grievances rather than an endorsement. Read it here: 

“For days, Abdul's only answer to the Rebellion PAC advertisement produced by Hasan Piker's uncle, Cenk Uygur, was that his campaign was 'not affiliated' with it. That ad tells Michigan families they cannot afford groceries because their money has to be set aside 'for killing Palestinians, and it blames our close ally Israel for everything Michiganders cannot afford. The chief executive of the Anti-Defamation League called it 'a case study in antisemitism! A disclaimer is not a condemnation, and everyone in my community knows the difference. I have learned from Democratic Party leaders and emissaries, as reported in the news media, that Dr. El-Sayed has heard the deep concerns of the Jewish community and is now, for the first time in this campaign, formally condemning that ad for what it is. That is why I accepted Congressman Clyburn's invitation to appear with Abdul on Sunday. 

I urge voters and the press to confirm it with Abdul directly.

"But the ad did not invent its argument; it dramatized one Dr. El-Sayed has made in his own words throughout this campaign: that Israel is the reason Michigan cannot afford schools, health care, and child care. The standard here is simple. If those words are wrong when a Political Action Committee supporting his campaign says them, then they are equally wrong when Abdul says them, and Abdul has said them from the start. I therefore expect him to apologize for those statements as well. Abdul promises to get money out of politics. He can begin by getting Israel out of his explanation for everything Michigan cannot afford. And it is my hope and expectation that, out of the same respect for Michigan's Black community, he will take down his own advertisement featuring white Christian nationalist Tucker Carlson, an insult to the congregation that will welcome us on Sunday.

"I say this with no race to run and nothing to gain. The Jewish and African American communities of my district deserve to see their leaders show up for them rather than fight over them. Jim Clyburn has spent his life showing what that looks like. I am honored to go to church with him."
celebrity.full_text_zh:
声明的实际内容比推文还要疯狂。她要求他为将高价与我们对以色列的支持挂钩而道歉。这是谴责和不满的清单，而不是认可。在这里阅读：

“几天来，阿卜杜勒对哈桑·皮克（Hasan Piker）叔叔岑克·维吾尔（Cenk Uygur）制作的叛乱政治行动委员会广告的唯一回答是，他的竞选活动与该组织‘无关’。该广告告诉密歇根家庭，他们买不起食品杂货，因为他们的钱必须用于‘杀害巴勒斯坦人’，并将密歇根人买不起的一切归咎于我们的亲密盟友以色列。反诽谤联盟的首席执行官称其为“反犹太主义的案例研究！”免责声明并不是谴责，我社区中的每个人都知道其中的区别，正如新闻媒体报道的那样，埃尔赛义德博士听到了犹太社区的深切关注，现在在这次竞选中首次正式谴责该广告的本质，这就是为什么我接受了克莱伯恩议员周日与阿卜杜勒一起出席的邀请。

我敦促选民和媒体直接向阿卜杜勒确认这一点。

“但这则广告并没有发明它的论点；它戏剧化了埃尔-赛义德博士在整个竞选过程中用自己的话表达的一个观点：以色列是密歇根州负担不起学校、医疗保健和儿童保育费用的原因。这里的标准很简单。如果支持他的竞选活动的政治行动委员会说这些话是错误的，那么当阿卜杜勒说这些话时，它们同样是错误的，而阿卜杜勒从一开始就说过这些话。因此，我希望他也为这些言论道歉。阿卜杜勒承诺从政治中获取资金。他可以从让以色列出于对密歇根州无法承担的一切的解释，我希望和期望，出于对密歇根州黑人社区的同样的尊重，他将撤下自己以白人基督教民族主义者塔克·卡尔森为主角的广告，这是对周日欢迎我们的会众的侮辱。

“我这么说并不是为了竞选，也没有任何收获。我所在地区的犹太人和非裔美国人社区应该看到他们的领导人为他们出现，而不是为他们而战。吉姆·克莱伯恩一生都在展示这一点。我很荣幸能和他一起去教堂。”

celebrity.full_text_en:
Yesterday at Princeton University, I had the honor of addressing some of the University's students and faculty about the place of Africa and Africans in the world, using Uganda as a case study. The overarching theme of my address, especially as Uganda just celebrated its 64th independence, was that Africa cannot be sovereign while Africans remain captive. It cannot be powerful while it's people remain powerless. 

Ugandans – Africans, really – MUST have a genuine opportunity to choose their leaders through credible democratic processes whose final outcome reflects their true will. Africans can’t truly exercise their sovereignty if they have no meaningful influence over the decisions that shape their life and future. 

But even beyond elections, Africans must still have the freedom to criticise their leaders and influence public decisions. Otherwise, democracy becomes a sham periodic exercise in which Africans temporarily participate in selecting their their next captors.
 
Although Africa need not blindly imitate institutions of other societies without considering our own circumstances, it must develop democratic institutions that are legitimate and responsive to the people they serve. Africa must build States strong enough to govern effectively, but not so powerful that their own citizens become helpless before them.
 
Those States, in turn, must then protect their sovereignty but without conveniently invoking it to insulate their ruling governments from being accountable to the citizens. Any legislation that African States enact to protect their sovereignty should be strictly tailored towards protecting the ability of their people to determine their own future without illegitimate foreign interference. It goes without saying that the rest of the world's interactions with Africa should ultimately be to support these objectives, otherwise Africans will keep bleeding on the rest of the world.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
昨天在普林斯顿大学，我有幸以乌干达为案例研究，向该大学的一些学生和教师讲述了非洲和非洲人在世界上的地位。我讲话的首要主题是，当非洲人仍被囚禁时，非洲就不可能拥有主权，尤其是在乌干达刚刚庆祝其独立 64 周年之际。当它的人民仍然无能为力时，它就不可能强大。

乌干达人——实际上是非洲人——必须有真正的机会通过可信的民主进程来选择他们的领导人，其最终结果反映了他们的真实意愿。如果非洲人对塑造他们的生活和未来的决定没有有意义的影响力，他们就无法真正行使主权。

但即使在选举之后，非洲人仍然必须拥有批评领导人和影响公共决策的自由。否则，民主就会成为一种虚假的周期性活动，非洲人暂时参与选择他们的下一个俘虏。
尽管非洲不需要在不考虑自身情况的情况下盲目模仿其他社会的制度，但它必须发展合法的、对其所服务的人民​​负责的民主制度。非洲必须建设足够强大的国家以进行有效治理，但又不能强大到让本国公民在国家面前变得无助。
反过来，这些国家必须保护其主权，但不能轻易援引主权来使其执政政府免于对公民负责。非洲国家为保护其主权而颁布的任何立法都应严格旨在保护其人民在不受非法外国干涉的情况下决定自己未来的能力。不言而喻，世界其他国家与非洲的互动最终应该是为了支持这些目标，否则非洲人将继续向世界其他国家流血。

celebrity.full_text_en:
🚨ALERT: Up to 5,000 users affected after a malicious Claude Code extension appeared on Cursor’s marketplace.

Cursor is an AI coding tool that helps developers write and edit software.

Users with auto-updates enabled could have downloaded it.

Cursor says the malicious version was not developed by Anthropic.

Other marketplace extensions, Grok Bot, Grok and its other SpaceXSI products were not affected.

Cursor REMOVED the package and took the attacker’s server offline.

As of October 30, Anthropic has released 2.1.314 update on Open VSX and Microsoft’s VS Code Marketplace.

Users SHOULD update. Those affected also need to follow Cursor’s cleanup steps and rotate credentials.

Uninstalling alone may NOT REMOVE the malware.

单独卸载可能无法删除恶意软件。

celebrity.full_text_en:
there's a difference between an AI agent that can make decisions and one that knows when it shouldn't.

that's something worth paying attention to with @meetmotes .

in financial applications, automation shouldn't mean giving an agent unlimited freedom. users need boundaries that actually matter, especially when assets and transactions are involved.

I'd rather see an agent that follows clear rules and handles a limited set of tasks reliably than one that promises to do everything.

more autonomy is useful only when it's backed by proper control.

prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.
prompts.usage_guide_zh: 将以上配置代码复制并保存到项目根目录下的 `.cursorrules` 文件中，Cursor 与 Windsurf 在每次生成代码和执行 Agent 任务时均会自动以此规范为最高准则约束输出。
prompts.usage_guide_en: Copy and save the above rules into `.cursorrules` in your project root directory. Cursor & Windsurf will automatically enforce these guidelines during agent coding.

prompts.title_zh: 竖屏微短剧（抖音/Reels）3秒爆点分镜剧本
prompts.purpose_zh: 高转化竖屏短剧分镜与台词
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。
音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

prompts.code_snippet:
# 1. 启动项目自动化分析与上下文轻量修剪 (避免上下文爆炸)
claude --compact

# 2. 静默批量执行单元测试与自动修复任务 (CI/CD 友好模式)
claude -p "Run all failing tests under tests/ and apply minimal surgical fixes. Do not touch unrelated files."

# 3. 指定单文件隔离审查模式 (限制仅允许读取特定子目录)
claude --allowed-tools "View,Replace,RunCommand" \
  --dangerously-skip-permissions false \
  -p "Audit security vulnerabilities in auth.py and output remediation report."

# 4. 自动化提交并生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的 Commit 信息
claude -p "Generate a git commit message following Conventional Commits format for staged changes."

prompts.title_en: Excel Advanced Report & Key Drivers Attribution
prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. 显存与上下文窗口优化：分配 16k 上下文并开启 KV Cache 压缩
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. 避免思维链自旋死循环的核心解码超参
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. 强力系统提示词：约束必须直接在 <think> 标签内进行深度反思，结束立刻给出最终结果
SYSTEM """
You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""

# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment

# 1. Video memory and context window optimization: allocate 16k context and enable KV Cache compression
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. Core decoding hyperparameters to avoid the endless spin loop of the thinking chain
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. Powerful system prompt word: Constraints must be reflected directly in the <think> tag, and the final result will be given immediately after the end.

Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""
